zh.title: 龐巴迪Global 8000獲准執飛倫敦城市機場（LCY）
zh.summary: 龐巴迪Global 8000獲英國CAA批准；可營運倫敦城市機場
body: 英國民航局（CAA）已批准龐巴迪（Bombardier）旗艦商務機Global 8000在倫敦城市機場（LCY）進行營運。這項於9月10日公布的認證，讓這款超長程商務噴射機得以進入距離倫敦市中心與金融區極近的機場。
龐巴迪Global 8000具備8,000海里航程與0.95馬赫的最大營運速度。倫敦城市機場因跑道長度僅約1,508公尺，且採用5.5度陡峭進場角而著稱，遠高於一般機場的3度標準進場角。
根據相關規定，Global 8000營運業者須取得飛機註冊地主管機關對陡峭進場補充文件的批准，並符合倫敦城市機場的營運規範，方可執行該機場的起降任務。

en.title: Bombardier Global 8000 Cleared by CAA for Operations at London City Airport (LCY)
en.summary: Bombardier Global 8000 receives UK CAA clearance for operations at London City Airport.
body: The UK Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) has approved Bombardier's flagship Global 8000 business jet for operations at London City Airport (LCY). Announced on September 10, the clearance allows the ultra-long-range jet direct access to the airport located near London's central financial district.

The Global 8000 features a published range of 8,000 nautical miles and a maximum operating speed of Mach 0.95. London City Airport requires aircraft to navigate a steep 5.5-degree approach angle compared to the standard 3-degree glide slope, along with a short runway measuring approximately 1,508 metres.

Under regulatory provisions, Global 8000 operators must secure steep-approach supplement approval from the aviation authority in their aircraft's state of registration and satisfy London City Airport's specific operational requirements before performing flights at the airport.
